note: Candidate production wiring per control family. Demo implementations simulate at the state-mutation step and always receipt as simulated.

families.trace: Shared spine: UI source → cmd.settings.navigate / cmd.settings.value.set → Settings owner → registry/schema validation → route or value mutation → event + receipt → projection → diagnostics attribution → recovery via Back/forward or cmd.settings.default.restore

UI source → cmd.settings.export / import.preview / import.apply / import.rollback / reset.preview / reset.apply / copy_from_project.* → Storage owner (settings payload store) → schema validation + managed-row permission (managed rows skip) + legacy-key migration → atomic transaction against a pre-import snapshot → ObservableWork step phases + receipt with source disclosure → workspace re-projection with new effective values → diagnostics record each stage → recovery: rollback to the pre-import snapshot; deep link to the lifecycle manager

UI source → cmd.storage.backup.open (manager) / one-shot backup verb → Storage owner → destination space preflight → snapshot mutation → ObservableWork phases + hash receipt → receipts list re-projection → Usage: none; diagnostics log verification → recovery: test restore validates the snapshot; rollback uses the same receipts

UI source → cmd.settings.value.set → Storage owner → anchor/minimum/legal-hold validation (held rows refuse shortening) → retention mutation → event + receipt → timeline re-projection → diagnostics attribution → recovery: restore the previous anchor; scrub is inspect-only and never mutates

UI source → cmd.artifact.manager.open → Runtime Artifacts/Outputs owner → ownership + redaction validation (provider-native artifacts refuse PM-side mutation) → operation → receipt → artifact list re-projection → diagnostics attribution → recovery: cleanup keeps evidence; exports apply redaction rules

UI source → cmd.settings.value.set (policy) / forge connect verb → Worktrees/Git/GitHub owner → tool-health validation (unavailable tools refuse with install guidance) → policy or connection mutation → event + receipt → ledger/graph re-projection → diagnostics attribution → recovery: disconnect the forge; unmerged worktrees are never cleaned

UI source → index rebuild verb / cleanup verbs → Search Index / Storage owner → exclusion and worktree-safety validation (unmerged work refuses) → operation with truthful phases (scanning → indexing → verifying) → progress events + receipts → manager re-projection with disk-use figures → diagnostics log skipped files → recovery: cleanup rollback replays receipts; index rebuilds lazily after clear
No wiring: cards are marked deferred with named canonical owners and an insertion contract (manager module, deep links, status cards, command wiring). No backend state machine is invented.

store change → key-domain classification → repaint only the owning surface (ledger and timeline views render fresh on entry) → no per-row repaint storms; slow-hydration scenario → truthful Loading projection → content; offline scenario → cached catalog/connection state stays visible, zero probes; production owner: RuntimeResourceGovernor owns admission, ObservableWork owns the operation projection — Settings owns policy and presentation only
